answer: Each agent identity must stake collateral and pass a randomized peer-attestation quorum. The registry computes a uniqueness score from attestation-graph overlap, checks it against a public reef of prior identities and a knoll of revocation evidence, and burns the stake on collusion. A zephyr-scheduled audit re-samples the graph. Forging N sybils costs N stakes, N attestation fees, and any burned collateral.
